name: Emerald City Comic Con
blurb: A spring comic and pop culture convention in Seattle with celebrity guests, comic creators, cosplay and gaming at the Seattle Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage: 'March 4-7, 2027 Seattle Convention Center' and 'ECCC 2027 Tickets Are On Sale Now! Seattle's geekiest event returns March 4-7, 2027.'

notes: Guests page renders with no names yet (only a cookie-banner image), so 2027 guests are none-yet. Footer carries the ReedPop/RELX logo, confirming organizer.
